actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.name: ticks

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

facts.text: The repository describes itself as a library for training humanoid locomotion in MJX and MuJoCo
The environment registry maps the name stompy to StompyEnv
get_env registers the selected class with brax and returns a brax environment
StompyEnv is a brax PipelineEnv subclass
StompyEnv builds its MJCF path as MODEL_DIR plus /stompy/stompy.xml
StompyEnv loads the model with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path and converts it with brax.io.mjcf.load_model
The environment declares four physics steps per control step and selects the mjx backend
The initial qpos is read from the model keyframe named default, and the reward function is built from the reward parameters and the environment time step
reset(rng) splits the key into three generators and adds uniform noise of plus or minus reset_noise_scale to the keyframe qpos and to the zero qvel before pipeline_init
step takes a brax State, advances it with pipeline_step, computes the reward and sets done to 1 - is_healthy when terminate_when_unhealthy is true
The model compiles in radians with autolimits enabled
The model option sets a 0.001 s timestep, 50 iterations, the PGS solver and gravity 0 0 -9.81
The root body carries three slide joints (root_x, root_y, root_z) and one ball joint (root_ball)
The left shoulder pitch joint declares range -3.14159 to 3.14159, actuatorfrcrange -80 to 80 and ref -0.534
The actuator section declares 31 motor actuators, each with ctrllimited true and ctrlrange -200 200
The model declares a keyframe named default with a qpos vector
The runtime stack lists brax, jax and mujoco-mjx
The package requires Python 3.11 or newer

determinism.notes: the bridge publishes no seed control for this engine: reset restores the model defaults with mj_resetData and the stand-in is a deterministic replay of the caller's control sequence, but that is not the upstream MJX environment, whose reset draws JAX random noise around the keyframe default pose

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the MJCF for the root slide/ball joints, the hinge and finger slide joints, the 31 motor actuators, their -200..200 ctrlrange and the 0.001 s option step, then gives each actuated hinge or slide a placeholder velocity proportional to its control value and holds the root joints fixed; it computes no inertia, torque, gravity, contact, friction, damping, armature, constraint or actuator dynamics and produces no MuJoCo trajectory
the stand-in loads no STL mesh or texture and resolves no collision, contact, equality, tendon or sensor; the 32 mesh assets and the plane floor are not applied

the upstream StompyEnv MJX environment is not exposed: its keyframe-default initial pose plus uniform reset noise, reward, healthy termination, observation assembly and metrics stay upstream; this package serves the raw cap.world.step.v1/cap.world.reset.v1 contract of the MJCF the environment loads

the environment runs four physics steps per control step (stompy.py:41) and selects the mjx backend (stompy.py:43); this package's bridge advances the model by one 0.001 s mj_step per requested tick and does not implement that control period or the MJX implementation
StompyEnv overwrites the XML solver with CG and sets iterations and ls_iterations to 6 (stompy.py:35-37); the raw-model bridge does not apply these overrides, and the fake models no solver
the environment resolves its model through MODEL_DIR (stompy.py:33); this package points model_path at the card model in the read-only clone and never sets or requires MODEL_DIR
the bridge's basic checkpoint profile restores only time/qpos/qvel/act/ctrl for the stand-in, not the full integration state, so snapshot_restore is declared false
MuJoCo itself and the JAX/MJX stack were not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine and the sim backend was not run
no physical Stompy is modelled by this package and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: bridge-owned lockstep integration stops; no step or world reset is accepted while latched. The integration state, velocities and controls are retained and readable. mhs.safety.reset only clears the latch; a new step is required and a step without action reuses retained controls
